annotations.title: Get a project's own-site backlinks from Bing

description: GetLinkCounts: own-site inbound-link page list for a project's matched Bing site — the focused, single-call form of the backlinks field already embedded in get_bing_site_overview. FREE (no credits). OWN-SITE ONLY: Bing exposes no competitor/any-domain backlink lookup, and some verified sites are known to return an empty result here even when populated. Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_bing_backlinks
